editorial:
You're on a dream vacation with your family, soaking up the sun on a hidden beach. But something is very wrong. People are aging years in minutes. Kids are growing up before your eyes. It's a wild, scary idea that grabs you right away and never lets go. The movie throws you into the mystery fast, and you'll keep wondering what's really happening on that sand. The setting feels beautiful but dangerous, and every scene adds a new layer of dread.

The acting is solid, especially the kids who have to play adults. The pacing is fast and keeps you guessing. Some moments feel a bit silly, and the dialogue can be clunky. But the tension never lets up, and the beach itself becomes a character. If you like mystery thrillers with a twist, this is for you.
endingExplained: It turns out the beach is part of a secret experiment run by a pharmaceutical company. They use the rapid aging to test new drugs on people in hours instead of years. The families are subjects who were tricked into visiting. In the end, two kids survive and escape with proof of the experiments. They hand the evidence to the police, exposing the company's crimes.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves mystery thrillers with a twist
